verdict.rationale: Porkbun documents availability and pricing checks across hundreds of TLDs, which covers breadth, and its registration flow includes an 'eligibility' pre-flight check that hints at handling restricted TLDs. Nothing in the evidence documents per-TLD special requirements such as country-code residency or restricted-TLD rules. Missing for 10: per-TLD requirements documentation, explicit ccTLD/restricted-TLD coverage, a TLD catalog listing, independent corroboration of TLD breadth.
